title: 云依助手 0.13.11
releaseNotes: Renamed saved packets to packet templates, opened on demand in a centered dialog without occupying the receive log. Existing templates and JSON imports remain compatible. Line endings, repeat interval/count and send/stop controls now scroll together with the left operation panel. TCP client, TCP server and UDP tabs have clear solid selection colors and keyboard navigation. Validated template management, responsive layouts, three themes and native loopback regressions.
